# Google Arts & Culture

> > Google Arts & Culture brings together 2000+ museums and cultural institutions worldwide through high-resolution digitization, AI experiments, and interactive tools for exploring art, history, and heritage.

The platform combines Google's Art Camera gigapixel technology, Street View virtual tours, and machine learning experiments (like Blob Opera and Art Selfie) to make cultural treasures accessible globally. Partners include NASA, MoMA, the Van Gogh Museum, and institutions across six continents.

## Key Topics

- AI experiments and machine learning
- Museum partnerships and collections
- Art Camera (gigapixel imaging)
- Virtual tours and Street View
- Art Selfie and Art Transfer
- Cultural heritage preservation
- Interactive art exploration
- Blob Opera
- Google Cultural Institute
- Educational resources
- Mobile app features
- NASA space exhibits
- Frida Kahlo and Van Gogh collections
- Art education and classroom tools
- Online exhibits and curation

## Overview

- [Google Arts & Culture](https://artsandculture.google.com): Homepage featuring 2000+ museums, AI experiments, and cultural treasures
- [About Google Cultural Institute](https://about.artsandculture.google.com): Mission to preserve & bring world's art online, partnership info
- [Experience Features](https://about.artsandculture.google.com/experience): App/web features: 2000+ museums, AR tools, Art Selfie, Street View tours
- [Partner Collections](https://artsandculture.google.com/partner): Directory of partner museums: MoMA, Orsay, Van Gogh Museum, NASA, Met

## AI & Interactive Experiments

- [Blob Opera](https://artsandculture.google.com/experiment/blob-opera/AAHWrq360NcGbw): ML experiment by David Li: create opera harmonies with AI voice synthesis
- [Art Selfie](https://artsandculture.google.com/camera/selfie): Art Selfie feature matches selfies to thousands of artworks globally
- [Doodle Guide](https://artsandculture.google.com/experiment/doodle-guide/FQFug-9023UsLw): Gemini-powered AI drawing assistant with real-time audio/visual feedback
- [Learning Light](https://artsandculture.google.com/experiment/learning-light/ywEbheTXDCXJCQ): Jack Wild's lighting design tool with Gemini AI tutorials & Luxbot chat
- [Say What You See](https://artsandculture.google.com/experiment/say-what-you-see/jwG3m7wQShZngw): Jack Wild's AI image prompt game testing visual description skills
- [Assisted Melody](https://artsandculture.google.com/experiment/assisted-melody/cAGcgh18Zi7DqQ): ML melody creator harmonizing in styles of Bach, Mozart, Beethoven
- [Learn Everything](https://artsandculture.google.com/experiment/learn-everything/qwGvFCEHA4HpQQ): Gaël Hugo's multimodal AI: learn topics via everyday object photos
- [What the Art?](https://artsandculture.google.com/experiment/what-the-art/lAHhUMfjdZKI7Q): Party game by LaBelle Games: sketch artworks, guess in multiplayer mode
- [Pet Portraits](https://artsandculture.google.com/camera/pet-portraits): Match pet photos to museum artworks via mobile camera feature

## Technology & Tools

- [Art Camera](https://artsandculture.google.com/project/art-camera): High-res Art Camera tech capturing artwork details from Rembrandt to Monet
- [AI Education Guide](https://artsandculture.google.com/project/ai): AI education guide with Scan bot exploring GANs & machine learning basics

## Explore & Discover

- [Weekly Highlights](https://artsandculture.google.com/recommended): Curated weekly exhibits: artist studios, Mona Lisa, Mount Fuji, NASA
- [Explore Feed](https://artsandculture.google.com/explore): Explore feed with artworks from Devi Art Foundation, Rembrandt, Sorolla
- [Artist Homepage](https://artsandculture.google.com/home/artist): Artist-focused homepage featuring Thomas Roberts & Heidelberg School art
- [NASA Collection](https://artsandculture.google.com/partner/nasa): NASA partner page: James Webb Telescope, astronaut photos, space exhibits
- [Celebrations Around the World](https://artsandculture.google.com/project/celebrations-around-the-world): Cultural festivals & traditions guide from museums worldwide

## Education & Learning

- [Learn With Google Arts & Culture](https://artsandculture.google.com/project/learn): Teacher resources, classroom guides, virtual field trips & lesson plans
- [Announcements & News](https://about.artsandculture.google.com/announcements): Latest news: Klimt ML revival, Blob Opera, Chopin project, climate art

## Virtual Tours

- [The State Tretyakov Gallery](https://artsandculture.google.com/streetview/the-state-tretyakov-gallery/DgFBweAX-vvW3Q): Virtual Street View tour of Moscow's State Tretyakov Gallery
- [The Bolshoi Theatre](https://artsandculture.google.com/streetview/большой-театр-интерьер/uQElUd0jgV2jeg): Street View interior tour of Moscow's historic Bolshoi Theatre
